description: Statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl, app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy-bms/COCRDUP.CPY and the shipped ASCII fixture, and NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing these programs is empirically impossible in this environment - there is no z/OS and no CICS emulator, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled and refuses a PROCEDURE ... USING program under -x, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, app/cpy/CUSTREC.cpy carries literal TAB characters that break parsing, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. That substitutes the PROVENANCE of the expected values and nothing else (AAP 0.7.6, practice B12, risk R-A, where the substitution is escalated for explicit user confirmation rather than silently absorbed). Every byte below is read out of three places and no fourth: the comparison and write-back at app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl:1498-1521, the field offsets of app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, and row index 0 of src/test/resources/fixtures/carddata.txt. Nothing here is a measurement of a run and it must never be described as one. THIS IS THE FOLDER'S CORE GATE G43 EVIDENCE: the case that proves the optimistic-concurrency check actually BLOCKS a rewrite. It is the exact mirror image of case16.json, and the two differ in EXACTLY ONE INBOUND BYTE - position 90 of the 329-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA image, CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD, which case16 carries as 'Y' and this case carries as 'N'. One byte of stale snapshot turns the folder's only successful CARDDAT write into a refused one. Everything else on the way in is byte-for-byte case16's, which is what makes the contrast attributable to that byte and to nothing else. THE UNIT IS THE SERVICE, NOT THE CONTROLLER. unitKind is SERVICE: card.CardUpdateService is constructed through its own constructor over a fixture-backed card.CardRepository - readForUpdateByCardNumber for the READ ... UPDATE at :1427-1436, and rewrite for the REWRITE at :1477-1483 which this case asserts is NEVER CALLED - and writeProcessing is called as a plain method on a plain object. There is NO MockMvc, no servlet container, no HTTP layer and no JobLauncher anywhere in the path (gate G51). BATCH_JOB and COMPONENT are both illegal for this program and neither is used. A DIRECT CONSEQUENCE WORTH STATING SO IT IS NOT READ AS AN OMISSION: because the unit is the service, this case's fingerprint is the UNWRITTEN record, the outcome state, the refreshed snapshot and the return message, and it does NOT assemble the seventeen-field COCRDUP screen. expectedResponse is therefore null and no xxxO, xxxA or xxxL item appears anywhere below. THE SEED. Row index 0 of fixtures/carddata.txt, byte-identical to row 0 of app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt and composed here from the CVACT02Y spans rather than pasted, so every offset is checkable against the copybook (practice B11): CARD-NUM X(16) 0500024453765740 at [1-16], CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) 00000000050 at [17-27], CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) 747 at [28-30], CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50) 'Aniya Von' followed by forty-one spaces at [31-80], CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) 2023-03-09 at [81-90], CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) Y at [91] and FILLER X(59) at [92-150]. 16 + 11 + 3 + 50 + 10 + 1 + 59 = 150, and that sum is the self-check: a FILLER dropped or shortened makes the total wrong immediately (gates G19 and G21). CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE IS MISSPELLED IN app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:9 and is reproduced verbatim as a field name in every map below (requirement I1); repairing the spelling would leave the differ looking for a field the decoder never produces, which is a silent parity break rather than a loud one. The fixture is in ascending CARD-NUM order, which is CARDDAT primary-key order, so the fixture line index IS the expectedFinalState row index. Rows 1 and 2 - Ward Jones on 0683586198171516 and Enrico Rosenbaum on 0923877193247330 - are seeded too and asserted unchanged, byte-for-byte as case16 asserts them. NO NORMALISATION IS DECLARED, and that is a measurement rather than an omission: carddata rows are already the full 150 bytes with a space-filled FILLER, and the only two markers ParityCase defines belong to cardxref, whose rows are 36 bytes against a 50-byte copybook, and to USRSEC. THE CONCURRENT CHANGE, AND IT IS DELIBERATELY CONSTRUCTED RATHER THAN FIXTURE DATA (practice B1, stated plainly so it is never mistaken for a shipped value). The inbound CCUP-OLD-* snapshot is built as though the screen had been painted from an EARLIER version of the row, and it DISAGREES with the seeded record in EXACTLY ONE of the six compared fields: CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD is 'N' where the stored CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS is 'Y'. One byte, unambiguous, and immune to case-folding subtleties, which is precisely why the status field rather than the name was chosen to carry the divergence. The other five agree with the seed exactly: CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD 747, CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME 'ANIYA VON' padded to X(50) and ALREADY UPPER-CASED because case06.json's read folded it through the INSPECT ... CONVERTING LIT-LOWER TO LIT-UPPER at :1356-1358, CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR 2023, CCUP-OLD-EXPMON 03 and CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY 09 from the (1:4), (6:2) and (9:2) slices at :1361-1366. CCUP-OLD-ACCTID 00000000050 and CCUP-OLD-CARDID 0500024453765740 also agree, and they are NOT part of the chain in any event. THE SAME OUTCOME IS REACHABLE THROUGH ANY ONE OF THE SIX, and that is why the field list matters rather than only the verdict: a translation that compared only a subset of the six - or that compared CCUP-NEW-* instead of CCUP-OLD-* - would pass THIS case while being wrong, because a divergence planted in a field it had dropped would sail through. The choice of the status field is what keeps this case cheap to read; the six-field enumeration below is what keeps it honest. THE REST OF THE INBOUND PAYLOAD, AND ALL OF IT IS PAYLOAD (gate G37). No conversation state is held server-side. EIBCALEN is 160 + 329 = 489: the shared CARDDEMO-COMMAREA of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, whose sixteen items sum to 160, followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA at :274-321, which is CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION X(1) plus CCUP-OLD-DETAILS 89 plus CCUP-NEW-DETAILS 89 plus CARD-UPDATE-RECORD 150. The extension is carried as one 329-byte image because that is exactly how :396-400 slices what came back. CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION is 'N', the 88 CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED at :286. CCUP-NEW-DETAILS carries the user's edits and every value is case16's: CCUP-NEW-ACCTID 00000000050, CCUP-NEW-CARDID 0500024453765740, CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME 'MARIA DEL CARMEN VON' padded to X(50), CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR 2027, CCUP-NEW-EXPMON 11, CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY 09 and CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD N. CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD IS THREE SPACES and it cannot be anything else: verified by exhaustive search, the item is declared at :306 and appears exactly once more, at :1464, as a SENDING item - it is assigned nowhere in the program, the COCRDUP map has no CVV field at all, and INITIALIZE CCUP-NEW-DETAILS at :586 is the last thing to touch it. It is carried here even though this case never reaches :1464, because the inbound image must be case16's for the one-byte contrast to mean anything (practice B5). The CARD-UPDATE-RECORD span still holds nothing but its INITIALIZE residue - SPACES in the PIC X items, ZEROS in CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) and CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD PIC 9(03) - because it is written nowhere but 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING, which this pass abandons before reaching :1461. The seven writable xxxI items are carried as mapFields at the widths app/cpy-bms/COCRDUP.CPY declares (ACCTSIDI X(11):60, CARDSIDI X(16):66, CRDNAMEI X(50):72, CRDSTCDI X(1):78, EXPMONI X(2):84, EXPYEARI X(4):90, EXPDAYI X(2):96), because 1100-RECEIVE-MAP re-reads them on this pass and they must agree with the extension's CCUP-NEW-* values byte for byte. PF5 IS PRESSED: aid DFHPF5, which CVCRD01Y renders as the 88 CCARD-AID-PFK05 VALUE 'PFK05'. The case is SELF-CONTAINED (practice B9) - it declares its own complete pre-state and depends on no earlier case having run. THE AID SURVIVES COERCION, :413-424. SET PFK-INVALID TO TRUE runs unconditionally first. The validity test then admits CCARD-AID-ENTER OR CCARD-AID-PFK03 OR (CCARD-AID-PFK05 AND CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED) OR (CCARD-AID-PFK12 AND NOT CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED), and it is the THIRD limb that matches: PF5 was pressed AND the state is 'N'. So PFK-VALID holds and the coercion IF PFK-INVALID SET CCARD-AID-ENTER TO TRUE at :422-424 DOES NOT FIRE. Had it fired, arm (e) below would have failed on its AID conjunct and no read-for-update would have happened at all. THE EDIT PASS WRITES NO MESSAGE, WHICH IS WHAT LEAVES WS-RETURN-MSG FREE FOR 9300 TO SET. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS reaches :680-683, where FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(CCUP-NEW-CARDDATA) is compared with FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(CCUP-OLD-CARDDATA) over the two 59-byte groups; they differ in the name, the year and the month, so SET NO-CHANGES-DETECTED does NOT fire. :685-686 then matches on CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED, sets all four FLG-*-ISVALID items and takes GO TO 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS-EXIT at :692, so 1230, 1240, 1250 and 1260 DO NOT RUN ON THE CONFIRM PASS and no edit can write a message. WS-RETURN-MSG therefore arrives at 9200 still OFF, at the SPACES :384 left in it. ONE PRE-LOAD WORTH RECORDING BECAUSE IT IS WHERE A PLAUSIBLE TRANSLATION GOES WRONG: :671-677 moves the SNAPSHOT into the work area, and two of those moves - MOVE CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME TO CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME at :673 and MOVE CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD TO CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS at :674 - land in the CARD-RECORD area that COPY CVACT02Y at :353 declares, the very area 9300 later compares. The READ at :1427-1436 specifies INTO(CARD-RECORD) LENGTH(LENGTH OF CARD-RECORD) and so OVERWRITES all 150 bytes of it, which is exactly why the comparison is against genuinely re-read bytes. A translation that skipped the re-read and compared the pre-loaded area instead would compare the snapshot with itself, match on all six every time, and never detect a concurrent change - it would pass every other case in this folder and fail only this one. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, ARM (e), :988-1001 (gate G30). The ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :949 is walked arm by arm. (a) WHEN CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :954 fails, the state being 'N' rather than LOW-VALUES or SPACES. (b) WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK12 at :958 fails, PF5 having been pressed. (c) WHEN CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS at :971 fails, 'N' not being 'S'. (d) WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK at :982 fails, 'N' not being 'E'. (e) WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED AND CCARD-AID-PFK05 at :988-989 MATCHES - both operands are true - so PERFORM 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING THRU 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT runs at :990-991. THE BARE SECOND TEST OF THE SAME 88-LEVEL at :1006-1007 IS THEREFORE NEVER REACHED: arms (e) and (f) test one condition twice and are told apart only by source order and by (e)'s AID conjunct, so a translation that deduplicated them or dispatched on the state character alone would save unconfirmed changes on a plain ENTER. Arm (g) at :1011 and the WHEN OTHER abend at :1019-1026 are not reached. 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING, :1420-1457. MOVE CC-CARD-NUM TO WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM at :1425 sets the RIDFLD; the MOVE CC-ACCT-ID-N TO WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID on the line above at :1424 is COMMENTED OUT and stays that way (practice B5). EXEC CICS READ FILE(LIT-CARDFILENAME) UPDATE RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) KEYLENGTH(LENGTH OF WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) INTO(CARD-RECORD) LENGTH(LENGTH OF CARD-RECORD) at :1427-1436 addresses file 'CARDDAT ' with a 16-BYTE KEY into a 150-BYTE record and TAKES THE UPDATE LOCK. It maps onto CardRepository.readForUpdateByCardNumber and is driven to NORMAL (gate G47) BY THE SEEDED DATA ITSELF - forcedOutcomes is empty, because a forced outcome exists to reach an arm no data can reach and NORMAL is not such an arm. THE LOCK SUCCEEDING IS ESSENTIAL AND IS WHAT SEPARATES THIS CASE FROM THE LOCK-FAILURE CASE: the check at :1441-1449 is IF WS-RESP-CD EQUAL TO DFHRESP(NORMAL) CONTINUE ELSE ..., and this pass takes the CONTINUE limb, so COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE at :205-206 is NOT set and the literal 'Could not lock record for update' MUST APPEAR NOWHERE in this expectation - asserted by the fact that the only message declared below is the DATA-WAS-CHANGED literal. PERFORM 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC THRU 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC-EXIT then runs at :1453-1454. 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC, :1498-1521 - THE OPTIMISTIC-CONCURRENCY CHECK, GATE G43, AND THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS CASE. First, INSPECT CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME CONVERTING LIT-LOWER TO LIT-UPPER at :1499-1501, over the literals at :260-263, folds the FRESHLY RE-READ record's name IN PLACE: the stored 'Aniya Von' becomes 'ANIYA VON', which is what makes it comparable with the already-folded snapshot. The fold is applied to the LEFT-HAND OPERAND ONLY - the record - and never to CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME. Then the SIX-FIELD AND-CHAIN at :1503-1508, and it is exactly six: CARD-CVV-CD equal to CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD, 747 to 747 - matches; CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME equal to CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME, 'ANIYA VON' padded to fifty against the same - matches; CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE(1:4) equal to CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR, 2023 to 2023 - matches; CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE(6:2) equal to CCUP-OLD-EXPMON, 03 to 03 - matches; CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE(9:2) equal to CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY, 09 to 09 - matches; and CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS equal to CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD, 'Y' against the stale 'N' - FAILS. Since the six are joined by AND, one failure is enough. CARD-NUM AND CARD-ACCT-ID ARE NOT COMPARED - six fields, no more, and a translation that added the key to the chain would be asserting something the COBOL never asks. The reference modifications are 1-BASED COBOL offsets into the ten-byte 'YYYY-MM-DD' string, re-derived by hand here: positions 1-4 are 2, 0, 2, 3; position 5 is the hyphen and is skipped; positions 6-7 are 0, 3; position 8 is the second hyphen and is skipped; positions 9-10 are 0, 9. THE COMPARISON IS AGAINST CCUP-OLD-*, WHICH IS WHAT THE SCREEN WAS PAINTED FROM, AND NEVER AGAINST CCUP-NEW-*: that is the entire meaning of the paragraph, and it is why the user's own four edits - name, year, month and status - cannot trip it while a third party's single change does. SO :1509's CONTINUE IS NOT TAKEN AND THE ELSE AT :1510-1518 RUNS, IN THREE PARTS. (1) SET DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE TO TRUE at :1511 - an 88 on WS-RETURN-MSG at :207-208 whose text is 'Record changed by some one else. Please review', reproduced byte-exactly below including the SPACE IN 'some one' as two words and the FULL STOP before 'Please', and padded on the right to the seventy-five characters WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :173 declares. RECORDED BECAUSE IT IS REAL AND NOT A TRANSCRIPTION SLIP: this SET is NOT guarded by IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF, unlike its counterpart at :1445-1447, so it takes effect whatever the field held. On this path nothing had written a message anyway - the edit paragraphs were skipped at :692 - so the outcome is the same either way, but the asymmetry between :1445 and :1511 is preserved rather than tidied (practice B5). (2) THE WRITE-BACK at :1512-1517, which is what lets the user retry against current data: all six CURRENT values are moved back into the snapshot fields - MOVE CARD-CVV-CD TO CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD (747), MOVE CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME TO CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME (the UPPER-CASED form 'ANIYA VON' padded to fifty, since the INSPECT at :1499-1501 has already run), MOVE CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE(1:4) TO CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR (2023), (6:2) TO CCUP-OLD-EXPMON (03), (9:2) TO CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY (09), and MOVE CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS TO CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD, WHICH FLIPS THE SNAPSHOT FROM THE STALE 'N' TO THE CURRENT 'Y'. All three values must stay distinguishable when this case is read: the stale inbound 'N' at position 90 of the image above, the stored 'Y' in the record, and the refreshed 'Y' in the snapshot the service returns. HOW FAR THE PUBLISHED CONTRACT LETS THAT REFRESH BE ASSERTED, STATED RATHER THAN WORKED AROUND (practice B4). ParityCase carries no member for an OUTBOUND program-specific commarea extension: ExpectedResponse.navigation admits CDEMO- names only, and its own documentation says a program's extension 'leaves in the response payload, not in that image', so pinning CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD there 'would assert a field the fingerprint does not carry'; ScreenSend.fields admits symbolic-map items only; and inventing a member, or inventing a COBOL DISPLAY the program does not emit, is refused outright. What is asserted instead is every part of the refresh the contract can hold, and it is not thin: the six values written back are the six the expectedFinalState entry below states byte-for-byte at the exact offsets :1512-1517 copies them from, so a translation that refreshed the snapshot from the wrong source could not agree with both; and the DATA-WAS-CHANGED literal is produced by no other arm of 9200, so it pins the outcome uniquely. (3) GO TO 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT at :1518 - a GO TO out of a performed paragraph into the CALLING paragraph's exit label, one of this program's twenty-one forward GO TO statements, and it ABANDONS THE REWRITE ENTIRELY. TWO FURTHER SOURCE PROPERTIES PRESERVED RATHER THAN TIDIED (practices B5 and R7). The BELT-AND-BRACES GUARD at :1455-1457, IF DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE GO TO 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT, is a SECOND and REDUNDANT exit for the same condition - :1518 has already left the PERFORM range by the time control could reach it - and both paths must produce the same outcome, which is the one asserted here. And the stray token 'END-IF EXIT' at :1519 is an oddity of the original: the behaviour is preserved and the structure is not straightened out. NOTHING IS WRITTEN, AND THAT IS THE ASSERTION. The assembly block at :1461-1475 and the EXEC CICS REWRITE at :1477-1483 are NEVER REACHED, so CardRepository.rewrite IS NOT CALLED - stated positively by an EMPTY expectedWrites list, which ParityCase defines as a positive assertion that nothing was written rather than an absence of interest, and reinforced by expectedDatasets pinning CARDDAT on the WRITES channel at rowCount 0 with recordLength 150, the strongest form of 'this dataset was reached and produced nothing' the model can express. THE SHARPEST CONSEQUENCE, AND THE REASON THIS CASE AND case16 BELONG TOGETHER: case16 pins the genuine legacy defect at :1464-1465, where CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD being SPACES is read back through the PIC 9(03) redefinition and silently replaces the card's real CVV with 000. HERE THAT DEFECT DOES NOT OCCUR, because the statements that cause it are never executed, and THE STORED CARD-CVV-CD REMAINS 747. If CARD-CVV-CD ever reads 000 in this file, the rewrite was wrongly allowed to happen and the case is wrong. THE OUTCOME STATE. Back in arm (e), the inner EVALUATE TRUE at :992-1001 is ordered and every arm tests an 88-level ON WS-RETURN-MSG, so which arm is taken depends on the text that field now holds. WHEN COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE fails - the lock was taken. WHEN LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED fails - no REWRITE was attempted, so :1491 never ran. WHEN DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE MATCHES, the THIRD arm, so SET CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS TO TRUE at :998 and CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION BECOMES 'S', the 88 at :281 (gate G30). WHEN OTHER at :999-1000 is not reached, which is the difference from case16. WHAT 'S' MEANS IS WORTH SPELLING OUT: the user is returned to the DETAIL SCREEN to review the values that actually won, NOT to a failure state. 'L' from CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR at :289 and 'F' from CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED at :290 are both members of the CCUP-CHANGES-FAILED grouping 88 at :288 and both leave through arm one at :438-439; 'S' is not a member of it and does not. A concurrency refusal is a retryable outcome and the state character is where the COBOL says so. MESSAGES, AND THE CLASS BOUNDARY THEY RESPECT. The service's one observable message is WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :173, and it is asserted below on the width-free DISPLAY_LINE channel because neither fixed-width channel is seventy-five - WS_MESSAGE_80 is eighty and SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 is seventy-eight, and for this mapset the screen field is not even seventy-eight, app/cpy-bms/COCRDUP.CPY:212 declaring ERRMSGO PIC X(80). THE SCREEN CONSEQUENCES BELONG TO THE CONTROLLER AND ARE DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED HERE: 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG's third arm at :1145-1146, WHEN CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS SET FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT, selects the WS-INFO-MSG PIC X(40) literal 'Details of selected card shown above' from the 88 at :160-161 and :1161 moves it to INFOMSGO, while :1163 moves WS-RETURN-MSG to ERRMSGO - and that selection is declared in CardUpdateController, not in CardUpdateService, so asserting it here would attribute to the service a decision the service does not make. Following the source and the declared class boundaries, this case asserts the service's outcome state and its message field and invents no screen. No COBOL DISPLAY is emitted on this path. GATE G44 - NO SCHEMA ARTEFACT. The entire mechanism is a re-read plus a six-field comparison plus a six-field write-back. THERE IS NO VERSION COLUMN, NO TIMESTAMP COLUMN, NO SEQUENCE NUMBER, NO DDL AND NO MIGRATION SCRIPT anywhere in this case or in the code it drives, and introducing one to replace the comparison would be a schema change the migration forbids outright. Only two of the twenty-eight programs carry this paragraph - this one and COACTUPC - so gate G43 scopes to the card and account packages. NEGATIVE ASSERTIONS, each verified by exhaustive search rather than assumed. NO CARDAIX ACCESS: LIT-CARDFILENAME-ACCT-PATH PIC X(8) VALUE 'CARDAIX ' is declared at :253-254 and REFERENCED NOWHERE in the program, and both account-id MOVEs into the RIDFLD, at :1379 and :1424, are commented out - so gate G45 holds in its strongest form, the alternate index being a finder method on the single CardRepository rather than a second table, and this program never invoking it at all. NO THANK-YOU AND NO INVALID-KEY TEXT: CSMSG01Y's CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU and CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY have zero references in COCRDUPC. NO WRITE, NO ADD AND NO DELETE: the program's only file-changing verb is the single REWRITE at :1478, which this case abandons, and CardRepository defines no add and no delete. NO ABEND: there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' anywhere in COCRDUPC, which is why expectedReturnCode is 0 and why gate G35 is inapplicable rather than merely unasserted. THE EXPECTED FINAL STATE IS THE NEGATIVE PROOF AND IS NOT OMITTED. It would be tempting to declare no row expectation on the grounds that nothing was written, but an absent expectation proves nothing whatever: it is the EXPLICIT, BYTE-IDENTICAL expectation that proves the rewrite was abandoned, and it is stated field by field rather than as one string so a single wrong byte is reported against the field that carries it (gate G17). ONE SUBTLETY HANDLED HONESTLY, BECAUSE IT IS THE MOST LIKELY WAY TO GET THIS CASE WRONG: the INSPECT at :1356-1358 in 9000-READ-DATA and the one at :1499-1501 in 9300 both upper-case CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME IN THE IN-MEMORY RECORD AREA, not in the dataset. Since no REWRITE occurs, the STORED bytes keep their original mixed case, so row 0 below asserts 'Aniya Von' and NOT 'ANIYA VON' - while the snapshot the same fold feeds, CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME, is upper case. Confusing an in-memory mutation with a persisted one would produce a fixture that looks right and asserts the opposite. DETERMINISM. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:33, the same instant case01.json and case16.json pin and the instant this source's own version footer carries (practice B7); the code page is named US-ASCII explicitly and is never the platform default (practice B8); every field value is given at its exact declared width with its exact trailing spaces; and both RESP outcomes are fixed properties of the seeded data rather than of timing. Gates asserted: G15 as case 17 of 20; G18 by diffing to zero; G19 at the 150-byte width; G21 with FILLER present and space-filled; G30 twice over - the walked outer EVALUATE reaching arm (e) where the bare arm (f) is never reached, and the inner EVALUATE stopping at its THIRD arm; G34 on the CC-ACCT-ID / CC-ACCT-ID-N redefinition pair carried in the payload; G37 with the whole conversation state in the payload; G43 as the six-field re-read comparison, the write-back and the abandoned rewrite; G44 with no version column and no DDL; G45 as the negative CARDAIX assertion; G47 with NORMAL on the read-for-update and no rewrite call at all; G51 by driving the service with no HTTP in the path; and requirement I1 through the misspelled field name. G32, G35 and G39 are deliberately NOT encoded: all twenty-one GO TO statements in this program are forward, there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' at all, and this screen has no pagination. RULES. review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided.', so NO user-specified rule governs this fixture and none has been invented; their absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar. It is held instead to enterprise best practice as the AAP records it - B1 with the one deliberately-divergent input declared as such rather than passed off as fixture data, B3 with every reference input under app/cbl, app/cpy, app/cpy-bms, app/bms, app/csd and app/data read and not one byte written, B4 with the contract's absent outbound-extension member documented rather than worked around, B5 with the unguarded SET, the redundant guard, the stray END-IF EXIT and the two commented-out MOVEs all preserved, B7 deterministic and non-interactive on a pinned clock, B8 with explicit widths, trailing spaces and code page, B9 self-contained, B11 with hand-verified offsets summing to 150, and B12 with the provenance limitation documented and escalated rather than absorbed.

expectedMessages.text: Record changed by some one else. Please review
